artwork.prompt: Album cover artwork, square format. A 2025 sleeve deliberately styled after 1980-1999. Medium: photocopied high-contrast collage with torn edges and visible tape. Subject: overlapping translucent ovals. Palette: bruised violet, teal shadow, hot magenta bloom, deep blue-black. Composition: chaotic layered collage, deliberately crude. No text, lettering, typography, watermarks, logos or signatures anywhere in the image.
